description: Computercraft is seeking a Biomedical Data Analyst to support the National Library of Medicine (NLM) at the National Institutes of Health in Bethesda, Maryland. NLM is the world’s largest biomedical and health research library and maintains a preeminent collection of biomedical literature and information resources. To make biomedical and life sciences literature accessible, NLM maintains PubMed (a publicly accessible search engine), which includes MEDLINE, a bibliographic database with more than 31 million references. MeSH (Medical Subject Headings), a distinctive feature of MEDLINE, is NLM’s controlled vocabulary thesaurus that gives uniformity and consistency to the references. In this role, you will work full-time providing data analysis and computational support for data-driven efforts to evaluate and improve the MEDLINE indexing product. Working under the technical direction and oversight of the Senior Biomedical Data Analyst and within established analytical approaches, you will support the processing, preparation, validation, and analysis of datasets, including PubMed web search and API user log data, used to evaluate MeSH vocabulary and automated MeSH indexing algorithm performance. You will assist with analyses of indexing performance and user search behavior and contribute to the development of data products, reports, and other analytical outputs used to inform improvements to MEDLINE indexing. Work performed by the Biomedical Data Analyst is subject to technical review and quality assurance by the Senior Biomedical Data Analyst. The Biomedical Data Analyst shall incorporate feedback, make necessary corrections, and maintain analytical code, documentation, and work products in accordance with established methodologies, technical standards, and quality requirements. This is a remote position. Job Responsibilities Support quantitative analyses evaluating automatic MeSH indexing and its impact on MEDLINE and PubMed users. Prepare and process PubMed GUI, API, user search and click, bibliographic, indexing, and other relevant datasets for analysis. Develop and execute scripts for data extraction, cleaning, transformation, aggregation, validation, and analysis using established analytical methods and requirements. Assist with the development, execution, testing, and maintenance of reproducible data processing and analytical workflows. Perform exploratory data analysis and apply established statistical and quantitative methods to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and relationships in data. Calculate and report established performance measures used to evaluate automated MeSH indexing, vocabulary performance, and related MEDLINE processes. Conduct data quality checks and investigate missing, inconsistent, anomalous, or unexpected data and analytical results. Assist the Senior Biomedical Data Analyst with analyses of PubMed user behavior and other data used to identify potential opportunities for improvements to automated indexing algorithms,

Det här är en möjlighet att bygga praktisk erfarenhet av klimatrapportering, dataprocesser och transparens i hållbarhetsarbetet samt få en inblick i de utmaningar som följer med datakvalitet, kontroll och uppföljning. Uppdrag och arbetsuppgifter När du gör en öppen ansökan till studentuppdrag inom klimatrapportering kommer du att ingå i vår kandidatdatabas. Det innebär att du får uppdateringar om nya relevanta uppdrag och kan komma att bli kontaktad direkt av våra rekryterare. Går du vidare med ett uppdrag kan du bli en del av arbetet med att samla in, analysera och kvalitetssäkra klimatdata. Uppdragen kan variera, men kan exempelvis innebära att: Stötta insamlingen av data för klimat- och hållbarhetsrapportering. Strukturera och analysera data i Excel. Säkerställa datakvalitet och rimlighet utifrån GHG-protokollet. Rapportera in data i system som t.ex. Position Green, Stratsys, CEMAsys eller SustainLabs. Sammanställa resultat och bidra till klimatbokslut och hållbarhetsrapport. Kompetenser och färdigheter Eftersom ansökan är öppen och de specifika uppdragen kan variera så är kompetensprofilen bred. Vi kommer att välja ut kandidater med goda förutsättningar att komma in i arbetet snabbt och smidigt då det ofta rör sig om tidsbegränsade uppdrag. Kravet är att du har: Goda kunskaper i excel och datahantering Viss erfarenhet av sammanställning eller rapportering av klimat- och hållbarhetsdata Meriterande God förståelse för GHG (greenhouse gas protocol) scoop 1-3. Praktisk erfarenhet av klimatbokslut eller hållbarhetsrapportering. God kunskap om rapporteringskrav och datainsamling för CSRD. För att lyckas väl i rollen tror vi att det är viktigt att du är noggrann, nyfiken och strukturerad och trivs i en roll där du får analysera, ordna och förstå data i detalj. description: Patent Data Specialist (Enrichment Quality & AI Readiness) Do you enjoy working hands-on with messy patent data, using SQL, Python and AI tools? Do you revel in finding the root cause of an error, then making sure it never happens again? Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent data, ready for the AI that professionals worldwide rely on. About the team: LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy. Every one of those decisions rests on the same foundation: patent data that is grouped, attributed, and kept up to date correctly. We are looking for someone who wants to help get that foundation right. About the role: Patent data is hard for people and machines alike. One invention can be filed in dozens of countries under different numbers and rules; one company can hold patents under many names, subsidiaries, and spellings; and whether a patent is still alive depends on events spread across years and jurisdictions. Any data or AI system built on top is only as good as the answers to a few basic questions. Which filings belong to the same family? Who really owns a patent once subsidiaries, acquisitions and spelling variants are untangled? Is a patent still in force, and do we know this for every country we are interested in? A single wrongly grouped family or misattributed owner can quietly change how a customer sees a competitor. In this role, you will work alongside senior patent data experts to define what correct looks like for these foundations, test our data against it, and track down why things go wrong. It is a rare chance to combine patent knowledge with hands-on data work, and to grow into a recognised expert in an area that underpins everything we do. Key Responsibilities: Work with our senior patent data experts to define and maintain governed quality standards and acceptance criteria for patent families, ownership, legal status, and coverage, including how to handle tricky edge cases. Build and maintain versioned test sets and worked examples, such as correctly grouped families or correctly resolved owners, that engineering teams build closed-loop evaluations on, so data quality is checked automatically and continuously. Analyse our data to find quality problems, investigate their root causes with engineering teams, recommend fixes, and help design checks so they do not recur. Lead smaller quality-improvement projects end to end, with support from senior colleagues. Assess the quality of data from new sources and patent authorities before and after it enters our platform. title: AI Engineer
description: About us At Koltin , we’re redesigning the way we care for our moms, dads, and grandparents to help them remain healthy and independent for as long as possible. How do we do it? Through our health memberships, which provide personalized, preventive care to support our members’ long-term well-being. Sobre el rol Buscamos a nuestro primer(a) Senior Software Engineer - Agents & LLMs. Nuestros miembros nos escriben decenas de miles de veces al mes, muchas veces con miedo, enojo o una historia detrás de la pregunta. Vas a poner agentes en producción para atenderlos, en un dominio donde la respuesta que suena bien y está mal es el peor error posible. Lo que construyas se vuelve la base de cómo toda la empresa construye con LLMs. Trabajas con producto, data y otros ingenieros, y decides qué construimos, qué compramos y qué ensamblamos. Generalista con una especialidad fuerte (modelo T): te mueves por todo el stack, con inclinación a LLMs y agentes. Lo que harás Agentes en producción. Orquestación, tool calling contra nuestros sistemas y el contexto del miembro armado desde múltiples fuentes, sobre WhatsApp y los canales que vengan. La barra de calidad. Evals sobre casos reales y criterios de aceptación definidos antes de lanzar. La plataforma. Observabilidad de LLMs (trazas, costo, latencia, calidad), evals como infraestructura, acceso a modelos agnóstico de proveedor y versionado de prompts, para que otros equipos no empiecen de cero. Seguridad en un entorno regulado. Guardrails, PII, verificación de identidad y human-in-the-loop donde el riesgo lo pide. Proyectos de punta a punta. Vas por el problema detrás del pedido, lo partes en fases y lo llevas a producción con visibilidad de riesgos y decisiones. Subir la vara. ADRs, review, pairing y patrones que otros equipos reusan. Lo que buscamos Contratamos por fundamentos, modelos mentales y patrones. El stack se aprende. Debe contar con un recorrido de al menos 5 años en el ciclo completo de desarrollo. Haber llevado LLMs en producción, con al menos un sistema frente a usuarios reales que operaste después del lanzamiento. Tool calling en serio. Diseñaste las tools y sabes qué hacer cuando el modelo llama la equivocada o con los argumentos equivocados. Evals en serio. Datasets de casos reales, LLM-as-judge calibrado contra humanos, regresiones antes de cada cambio de prompt o modelo. Datos sensibles en producción: PII, retención, acuerdos de procesamiento con proveedores. Español nativo o fluido, inglés profesional. Suma puntos Context engineering: compactación, memoria, context provisioning vía tools. Retrieval agéntico y servidores MCP, más allá de RAG sobre embeddings. Seguridad de agentes: prompt injection directa e indirecta, permisos mínimos por tool, red-teaming. Multi-agente, subagentes y ejecución durable. Costo y latencia:
